entity_raw.definition_raw:
When you gather your might, it lasts long enough to improve your defenses and attacks of opportunity.

Prerequisite(s): Gather Might, gather power class feature, kineticist level 8th.

Benefit(s): When you use Gather Might, the ability score bonuses last until the beginning of your next turn.
